title: The Ticket Closed. Did the Escalation?
excerpt: The technical fix may be done while the customer still has an open decision. Use a clear exit test before declaring an account escalation over.
primary_goal: Decide whether to close an account escalation, move residual work to a named owner, or keep the escalation open.
primary_cta: Use the Escalation Exit Note on one live account escalation before changing its status.
playbook_description: A one-page close, handoff or keep-open decision for account escalations.

subject_variants.subject: The ticket closed. Did the escalation?
subject_variants.preheader: A simple exit test for the customer impact, open work and next owner.
